recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, dark-themed composition featuring a central horizontal glowing line that divides the canvas, set against a grainy black background with sparse white starlight dots and heavy slab-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical vertical balance between top and bottom text blocks
High contrast between white graphic elements and deep black background
Textural harmony between the grainy canvas and the distressed letterforms
Linear focus created by the central horizontal divide
coreInvariants: Heavy grain/noise texture across all surfaces
Central horizontal white line with soft outer glow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Text is positioned in the upper and lower thirds, centered horizontally; the dividing line sits exactly at the vertical midpoint.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central horizontal line acts as the primary anchor, drawing the eye across the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down to the central line, and settles on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space creates a sense of vastness and isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal to black background with heavy digital noise.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white to light gray for text and the central line.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Small, bright white points representing stars.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between dark background and light foreground elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with blocky terminals
letterConstructionRules: Distressed or textured fill within the letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature a subtle inner shadow or bevel effect to suggest depth against the grain.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both primary text elements to maintain absolute symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and blocky structure.
Provides the necessary geometric slab feel with wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black background with a heavy film grain texture. Add a single, thin horizontal white line across the center with a soft outer glow. Scatter a few small, sharp white dots randomly to simulate distant stars.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two lines of text in a heavy slab serif font, one in the top third and one in the bottom third. Use all caps with wide tracking. Apply a grainy texture to the text fill so it blends with the background noise.

verificationChecks: Is the central line perfectly horizontal?
Is the text centered and tracked widely?
Is the grain texture consistent across the entire image?
Is the color palette strictly monochromatic?

mustRedesign: Unique hand-drawn imperfections in the line

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of slab serif type

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not touch the central line.
Verify that the grain does not obscure the letterforms.
Check that the horizontal line spans the full width.
Confirm the absence of any non-grayscale pixels.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured black void with a central glowing horizon line and symmetrical, wide-tracked slab serif typography for a minimalist cosmic aesthetic.
